manifest.order: per case: tree order alternates, variant order rotates

fix.bar: the fixed production at least as fast as the old one in both phases (median of paired moves per second), zero violations; exactness is shown by ScoringExactnessTest

b.bars: against the fixed production: fairness-phase median at least 1.25x, no case less fair beyond its spread, median cost not above the baseline, every accepted result inside its ceiling

c.bars: against the fixed production: fairness-phase median at least 1.25x, no case less fair beyond its spread, median cost not above the baseline, every accepted result inside its ceiling

decision.load-balance: compared on every measure, no bars: a change of fairness policy is an owner decision
